title: project — project/task/stage management deep L3

key_findings.finding: Task closure is determined by the task state field (values 1_done and 1_canceled via the CLOSED_STATES dict at project_task.py:84-87), NOT by any is_closed field on the stage model; project.task.type has no is_closed field
key_findings.migration_relevance: Any migration logic checking stage-level closure must reference the task state field, not a stage attribute

key_findings.finding: Task state is a 6-value computed+stored Selection driven partly by dependency blocking: when any depend_on_ids task is open, the blocked task is automatically set to 04_waiting_normal; state and stage are orthogonal
key_findings.migration_relevance: Migration must preserve both stage_id and state independently; the state machine will re-compute state from dependencies post-migration

key_findings.finding: The base project module defines account_id on project.project (optional, no auto-creation); auto-creation of the analytic account only happens when hr_timesheet is installed and allow_timesheets is enabled
key_findings.migration_relevance: Migrated projects from systems with timesheets must include account_id; projects without timesheets may have null account_id

key_findings.finding: Task stages (project.task.type) are shared across projects via a Many2many; a stage can belong to multiple projects simultaneously; the domain on task stage_id is [project_ids = project_id]
key_findings.migration_relevance: Stage migration must handle the M2M relation; creating duplicate stages per project would diverge from community behaviour

key_findings.finding: The Burndown Chart reconstructs history from mail_message and mail_tracking_value audit trail using a CTE with generate_series; it requires stage-change tracking messages to be present in the mail log
key_findings.migration_relevance: If mail tracking messages are not migrated, burndown chart will show only current state without history

capabilities: CAP-U142-01: Project container and privacy visibility
CAP-U142-02: Task model fields and state machine
CAP-U142-04: Task stages (shared, fold, rotting, rating)
CAP-U142-09: Built-in reports (task analysis and burndown chart)

cross_module_notes.hr_timesheet: Adds allow_timesheets, timesheet_ids, effective_hours, progress, overtime, remaining_hours to project and task; auto-creates analytic account when timesheets enabled
cross_module_notes.analytic: Provides account.analytic.account model; project inherits analytic.plan.fields.mixin
cross_module_notes.portal: Provides portal.mixin for access URL and portal access; project access at /my/projects/{id}
cross_module_notes.rating: Provides rating.mixin; periodic rating dispatched by daily cron on project.task.type
